summary: Re-reviewed the landed body in src/text1b_tu1b.c (layer2 hash dd3df377fee24532; sandbox --disable all = 0, 76/76 insns). Item 2: no asm, pins, barriers or build changes, and the diff touches only src/include/metrics. Item 3: the one codegen-shaping construct, `s32 arg1_copy; arg1_copy = arg1;`, carries a FAKE with a measured reason. I re-measured it: dropping the copy scores 6 (75 vs 76), and so does typing arg1 as u8 * without the copy (tmp/l2v/r2/a.c, b.c). The target really does copy $s0 into $v1 for the +0x08 store. The S414 fields checked against func_8007352C (text1b_tu1e.c:123): header (+0) is read as SprtHdrA; all three sheets have count 1 at +2. p_static (+4) is read as the SprtEntA table, matching D_800A328C's {0,0,0,0,0x14,0x0E}, which equals the original words 0 / 0x0E140000. x/y (+0x18/+0x1C) are added to the cell x/y. arg1_field (+8, out), zero10 (+0x10, semi, stored 0 here), arg2_field (+0x14, ot_idx), byte28 (+0x28, has_color, stored 0) and the pads are uninformative but assert nothing false. The (s32) casts at func_8007352C, func_8006E480, SetDrawMode and AddPrim match those functions' declared s32 parameters and are not lies. The D_8009B850[] comment matches the data and the use. Item 4: D_8009B850 is now an array; its only references are this C body and asm/funcs/func_80060414.s / asm/text1b.s (this same function's asm), so there is no second extern. D_800A328C goes through game.h's typed extern, and D_800A3290 is retired with no remaining users. No header declares D_8009B7AC/B8/C4, and no header type exists for the descriptor. Item 5: there is one FAKE and no known zero-FAKE form.
